name: building_rc_network_3r2c
title: 3R2C building thermal network with weather lookup
summary: Single-zone building thermal network with three thermal capacitances (indoor air, opaque facade, internal masonry walls) coupled through thermal resistances, integrated over one week of July weather read from a lookup table; ventilation is the only heat sink (free-running zone).

authors: TBD (author of the original EES model of the CLIM R06 repetition exercise 2)
origin.course: CLIM (Climatisation, University of Liège), repetition exercise 2

verification.reference: no EES stored solution exists (the model is not in CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip and no file of ~/Nextcloud/thermo_models uses this system); the native file was verified (1) against the former runnable variant (exact piecewise-linear reconstruction of the weather table, itself checked against INTERPOLATE of the shipped table: 24 sampled points, max 1.07e-14 C): all 56 common variables and the 13 columns of the 1001-row trajectory equal, max relative difference 5.1e-12; (2) against an independent classical RK4 integration (h = 15 s, Python, hourly linear interpolation of the same table) of the same equations: T_in(604800 s) 30.68246 (RK4) vs 30.68246 (CoolSolve), max |difference| over the trajectory 0.0028 K on T_in (at tau = 115517 s), 0.0002 K on T_c_wall and T_c_in
verification.notes: Native file (INTERPOLATE inside the INTEGRAL model) verified with CoolSolve fix/library-gaps-2 (CS-GAP-INTEGRAL-LOOKUP closed); the native file is now the verified file and the _coolsolve variant was removed. max_rel_diff is the largest relative deviation of the CoolSolve trajectory (T_in, T_c_wall, T_c_in at the 1001 output rows) from the RK4 reference interpolated at the same times; the RK45 time march of CoolSolve with default tolerances, not the model, sets it. No EES reference: the status follows the independent re-computation, as for the other verified models of the library without an EES file.
